messages:
jordan-cust: Hey, hitting intermittent failures from /embeddings — some responses come back with dim=1536 but our model expects 768. Started after we switched to the new embeddings model yesterday. Error: `InvalidEmbeddingDim: expected 768 got 1536`. Using python SDK v0.8.2. Anyone seen this?

alex-support: Thanks for the report — can you paste a minimal repro (request + headers) and one failing request_id? Also are you batching multiple inputs or sending single-item requests?

jordan-cust: Sending batched arrays (batch size 4) via python sdk. snippet: ```python
from redwood import EmbeddingsClient
client = EmbeddingsClient(api_key=TOKEN)
texts = ["a","b","c","d"]
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="rwd-embed-768", input=texts)
print(len(resp.data[0].embedding))
```
Got 1536 for some calls, sometimes 768. request_id: req_01H8Z9XYZ

alex-support: ok got it. tagging eng: @maria-eng and runtime: @ryan-runtime. Also did you set any custom batching or use our SDK batcher defaults?

maria-eng: :eyes: thanks for tagging. Quick note — if there's a dim doubling it often means two vectors concatenated or a padding bug. We'll try to repro with the python SDK + batcher.

ryan-runtime: I kicked off a local repro with the provided snippet and SDK v0.8.2. I'm seeing consistent 768 when requests are single, but when I run high concurrency (12 threads) with batch_size=4 I occasionally see 1536 and this stack in logs: ```ERROR runtime: embedding_response_validation.go:45 InvalidEmbeddingDim expected=768 got=1536 trace=req_01H8Z9XYZ```

alex-support: any temporary mitigation we can give customer?

maria-eng: There's a known race in the SDK batcher where two partial batches can get merged incorrectly for certain async flush paths — result is concatenated outputs. Workaround: set environment var to force batch_size=1 or disable client-side batching until patch. Example: `export REDWOOD_EMB_BATCH_FORCE=1` or in code `client = EmbeddingsClient(..., max_batch_size=1)`.

jordan-cust: ok, I can try forcing batch_size=1. Is there a release with a fix?

ryan-runtime: filing internal bug BC-3481. We'll push a patch to python/ts SDKs. Patch landed in a branch that ensures batch flush is single-thread safe and validates per-item dims before returning.

maria-eng: Quick patch snippet we applied in CI (Python SDK): ```diff
--- sdk/embeddings/batcher.py
+++ sdk/embeddings/batcher.py
@@
-    merged = _merge_partial_batches(a, b)
+    # ensure we never merge buffers from concurrent flushes
+    if a.flush_id != b.flush_id:
+        raise RuntimeError("concurrent-flush-merge")
+    merged = _merge_partial_batches(a, b)
```
This adds an extra guard and also double-checks output dims before returning.

alex-support: ETA on release?

maria-eng: We validated in unit/integration tests; will cut a patch release today: python SDK v0.8.3 and ts SDK v0.6.7. Release notes mention: "Fix batcher race causing dim concat for embeddings under high concurrency."

jordan-cust: Thanks — forcing batch_size=1 fixed it locally. Please send the pip/ npm command when available and we'll upgrade.

deploy-bot: deploy started for release/sdk-embeddings-fix (sha: a1b2c3) :rocket:

maria-eng: Ship done. Upgrade commands: `pip install redwood-sdk==0.8.3` or `npm install @redwood/sdk@0.6.7`. Also you can keep batching enabled after upgrade.

jordan-cust: Upgraded and verified multiple runs at 100 concurrent requests, all dims 768 now. Closing on our side :thumbsup:

alex-support: Great — marking as resolved. If you see any perf regressions post-fix please reopen and include `request_id`s.

maria-eng: Follow-up: we'll add a server-side assertion to detect any dim anomalies and return a clearer 5xx with `embed_dim_mismatch` code if they show up in future.

jordan-cust: Appreciate the quick turnaround everyone :heart:
